 Hi William,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How is it going? Believe it or not, September is almost here already! I hope you’re still fully enjoying the warm season as it comes to a close and that, like us, you’re just as excited to welcome the crisp air of fall, with its dazzling colors and, quite sadly, shorter days.

 

 For the iconic monarch butterflies that we made our company's mission to save from extinction , the arrival of fall is the trigger to begin their epic migration —traveling more than 4,000 miles south across the continent , all the way to the forests of northern Mexico and California.

 

 All summer long , we watched them peacefully as they flew, laid eggs, hatched, fed, formed their chrysalises, and emerged once again by the thousands in our vast milkweed fields —now serving as an emergency refuge for them at a time when, everywhere else, milkweed, the only host plant and food of their caterpillar, is being destroyed through pesticides, municipal mowing, and urban expansion on once-wild farmland.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 As a token of thanks for this lifeline, the monarchs offer us an invaluable gift each year: tons of seed pods , born of their precious pollination work, filled with seeds and silky fibers whose many properties had long been forgotten —until quite recently!

 

 Milkweed fibers are naturally hollow (like polar bear hair), forming tiny tubes that trap air and create an exceptional thermal, acoustic, antibacterial and water-repellent barrier . Light yet highly insulating , they rival—or even surpass—synthetic and animal materials like Primaloft, goose down or merino wool, without the ecological or ethical cost. Coated in a natural wax, these fibers repel both rain and snow from the outside and moisture/sweat from the inside, keeping you warm and dry in all conditions, with thin clothes or accessories.

 

 We use these hollow fibers as the main insulation component in more than 30 products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_0) that we manufacture locally with partially automated equipment: 

 

 
 
 Some made for winter , like our popular mittens (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_1), scarves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_2) , neck warmers (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_3) , insoles (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_4) and beanies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_5) that were tested and approved in the Arctic's freezing temperatures.

 Some made for summer and lifestyle, like our lunch bags (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_6) and can cozies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_7) that use milkweed's tremendous insulating power to keep food and drinks fresh.

 

 

 Milkweed is a true, rare win-win for nature and humans. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Every year around mid-September, we host an exclusive online event for our customers and newsletter subscribers: our Annual Fall Presale, where all products on lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K3XQB7F94VMAPMJVH1YVJXBR_8) are up to 20% off for a limited time and while supplies last—and where we also unveil our much-awaited new milkweed products.

 

 This is a pretty good time to plan ahead—whether by choosing original, sustainable holiday gifts made with milkweed, or by getting your family ready for the cooler season. 

 

 It also helps us anticipate the strong demand more precisely ( in the past two years, we had to stop taking Christmas orders by the end of October ) while also ensuring the survival of our milkweed fields and the endangered monarchs that will rely on it next summer.

 

 Since you’ve subscribed to our newsletter or purchased milkweed seeds from us in the past, we guess this cause matters to you . Now that you’ve gotten to know us a little better, we’d love if you considered supporting this year’s Presale by trying one of our products. And even if you don’t need anything right now, simply sharing our story with friends and family helps our mission more than you can imagine!

 

 
 So in the next few weeks, please stay tuned for our upcoming emails with more details about the products , direct links to the presale collection, exclusive discount codes and more! To make sure you don’t miss a thing, we invite you to add hey@lasclay.com to your email contacts so our messages don’t end up in your spam folder .

 Thank you, once again, for helping us carry out our mission: making milkweed accessible through affordable, sustainable, efficient and well-crafted products —while contributing to the protection of monarch butterflies. Your support truly means a lot to us. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.

Products with minor cosmetic flaws, returns, or repairs, offered at reduced prices. 

 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why this once-a-year event is crucial for the future of Lasclay, the milkweed industry and monarch butterflies

 
 This pre-sale is about so much more than getting a high-performance coat at a discounted price. It’s a turning point for the future of Lasclay and the survival of monarchs in North America.

 We’ve reached a critical moment. 

 Out of the more than 200 farmers who began growing common milkweed in the USA and Canada between 2013 and 2018, only 25 remain today. They urgently need income, hope, and market opportunities to keep this pioneering crop alive—one that’s become a lifeline for the endangered monarch butterfly.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 On the brink of extinction, monarchs made an inexplicable and remarkable comeback. Every summer, multiple generations of butterflies breed on milkweed plants before migrating back to their overwintering areas in Mexico. After which, we collect their gift: milkweed seed pods, containing precious insulating silk. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A female monarch laying eggs in an organic, commercial milkweed field. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A recent study from the University of Guelph (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0JB6PTGCBVHV2N2NA0ZC_21) , covered by both Canadian and American media, highlights the urgency of the situation: monarch butterfly populations are alarmingly low . The researchers call for a coordinated North American action plan to protect and restore their populations before it’s too late. 

 Milkweed fields do just that and milkweed-based products are a great way to support them. 

 

 
 No matter which milkweed product you choose—whether it’s for winter, summer, or home— every purchase directly supports monarch butterflies by increasing the demand for milkweed, and in turn, supporting the profitability and long-term survival of milkweed fields— critical breeding grounds where monarchs thrive and drastically increase their numbers all summer long before embarking on their epic 4,000-mile migration through Canada, USA and Mexico. 

 With your support and trust, we can set this wheel in motion and pave the way toward a bright future for milkweed—elevating it to the status it truly deserves. That’s been our dream from day one. 

 This incredible plant deserves it. The monarch butterflies deserve it. The hardworking milkweed farmers deserve it. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are you ready to do your part in this great mission? 

 

 
 It’s possible to pre-order all products from our shop starting now, but exclusive promo codes will be available beginning September 13 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time for the first buyers of the season.

 IMPORTANT NOTE: Most of our customers are on the East Coast, which is why the launch starts at 9:00 a.m. If you’re on the West Coast and it is too early for you to get the 20% discount, just go ahead and place your order later on Saturday the 13th using the 15% off code . If you then email us at hey@lasclay.com , we’ll be happy to adjust your discount to 20%. 

 

 Here are the different discount codes and their time windows: 

 
 
 LASCLAY20 (20% off during the first 60 minutes, from 9:00 to 10:00 a.m. EST)
